title: refactor: move FLUX GPU backend under operations
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves the active FLUX/Nunchaku worker from image.pollinations.ai/nunchaku to operations/infrastructure/gpu/flux.
- Updates provisioning, local setup, verification, fleet inventory, and skill links for the new path.
- Adds a deployment-detection test proving GPU infrastructure changes select zero Cloudflare operations apps.
- Changes no model behavior, routing, credentials, pricing, or live Vast instances.

Operational note:
- Existing FLUX workers keep running their currently checked-out files.
- Do not pull this commit into an existing worker checkout by itself: its generated /root/run-flux.sh points at the old path.
- On a future reprovision or intentional worker update, run setup-vast.sh from the new path so it rewrites the restart command before relying on the new checkout.

Validation:
- operations deployment-detection tests
- shell syntax checks for every moved script
- Python compilation checks
- stale-path and relative-link checks
- git diff --check

Stacked on #13240.

gist.headline: FLUX found its toolbox
gist.blurb: The FLUX/Nunchaku GPU worker moved into the operations garden, where provisioning notes, fleet inventory, and setup scripts can grow together. Existing workers keep calmly buzzing along.
gist.summary: Moved the active FLUX/Nunchaku GPU worker from image.pollinations.ai/nunchaku to operations/infrastructure/gpu/flux, updating provisioning, verification, local setup, fleet inventory, and deployment-detection coverage without changing model behavior or live instances.
gist.impact: GPU operators now have the FLUX worker and its setup-vast.sh reprovisioning workflow in the operations infrastructure tree, while existing Vast workers continue running their current checkouts.
